svg.text: LensS is the product. Genie is one engine inside it.
Everything inside the frame is LensS: what runs today, and what plugs into the same platform next.
Data or app, quick or deep,
Genie answers one domain’s questions. LensS decides who answers, checks every answer, adds context and action,
and grows by plugging in more agents, models, data and connections, while users keep the same experience.
LensS Collections Intelligence · Concentrix Data & Analytics Practice
